articles.summary: Most enterprise AI projects spend weeks in discovery before anyone sees anything customized to your environment. Bretton’s Agent-in-a-Day inverts that. We go onsite with your team, start from your actual workflow and policies, and configure working agents using the capabilities already built into the Bretton AI platform. The goal is to get to a working, customer-specific agent created quickly enough that your team can shape it directly and leave with a clear path to production.
